name: Kimchi
siboNotes: While kimchi is fermented and may support gut health, limit portions due to fructan content from garlic and onions commonly used in preparation. Some SIBO patients may tolerate it better than others due to beneficial bacteria.
preparationTips: Look for brands with minimal garlic and onion ingredients
Start with small portions to test tolerance
Rinse lightly if very sensitive to reduce sodium and some FODMAPs
Check ingredient lists as recipes vary significantly between brands
